scope.summary: Implement indexing building a topic/subtopic hierarchy of at least four levels through inserted index marks, with sort-by overrides, per-reference page-range scoping (to next style change, to next use of style, to end of story/document/section, or a custom paragraph count), and cross-reference forms (See, See also, See herein, See also herein, and custom). A generate-index operation produces the formatted index story with title style, nested vs run-in format, section headings, include-book-documents, and include-hidden-entries. Capture shortcuts MUST index the selected word and proper names (last-name-first). Index story is a StudioTextStory.
acceptance_criteria: >=4-level index with scoping + cross-reference forms + capture; generate-index produces formatted story
proof_targets: index-mark hierarchy + generate-index runtime; scoping + cross-ref test
expected_tests: live: index marks build >=4-level hierarchy; generate-index produces formatted index story with nested/run-in format
test: page-range scoping variants + cross-reference forms + capture proper-name (last-name-first)

risk_if_missed: No index generation; reference/technical books cannot be indexed.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
